page.overview:
Who is Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai?

This article is about the distribution of One Power strength among Third Age Aes Sedai. For a list of all strength rankings and an explanation of the numbering system, see One Power strength rankings.

The following table gives a full list of strengths of Aes Sedai according to their entries in The Wheel of Time Companion. If there are no Aes Sedai at a given level, it is not included below. Those who are in training as novices are marked with *, those who are Accepted are marked with **. The Kin are not included in this list. See Strength in the One Power among the Kin for more details. {| class="wikitable sortable" style="background-color: #dimgray;" border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="5" ! style="text-align:center;" | Strength Level ! style="text-align:center;" | White Tower initiates ! style="text-align:center;" | Notes

Some modification and explanations are required:

The Companion lists Cadsuane's strength as , which would be significantly stronger than Elayne/Egwene/Aviendha's potential and just below Nynaeve. Additionally, the Companion entry for Tamela calls the Wise One "the equal of Cadsuane, with a strength level of ".
